settings.enabled_help: Turn this off to show every link to everyone again, without losing your domain list.
settings.domains_help: One domain per line, for example mega.nz. Subdomains are included, so mega.nz also covers folder.mega.nz. Leave empty and nothing is gated.
settings.html_help: The HTML shown where a gated link used to be. Anything you would put in a post works here. Leave empty to show the plain wording below instead.
settings.fallback_help: Used where HTML cannot go, in particular notification emails. Keep it short and say where the link can be found.

translations.label: Other languages
translations.help: What you wrote above is shown to everyone. Fill in a language here and readers using it see that instead. Leave one blank and it falls back to what you wrote above.

forum.fallback: This link is available to members only.
